channels.name: Private Practice Skills
channels.description: Dr. Marie Fang, licensed clinical psychologist — ~60,000 subscribers teaching therapists exactly what the founder's research said didn't exist: how to start, market, and run a private therapy practice as a business. Weekly videos since 2018.
channels.focus: Business of running a therapy private practice
channels.verificationMethod: Found via a broader search beyond the founder's research, which had explicitly found no confident channel candidate. Extremely well corroborated — 8+ independent sources (her own site, multiple podcast guest interviews, a direct channel fetch) all confirming the same person, channel, and subscriber count. Global, not Nigeria-specific.

notes: The founder's own research flagged one Nigerian lead as explicitly unverified: Dr. Sonia, a real, credentialed Lagos-based therapist, is credited (via her own bio on TherapyTribe) with authoring a book titled 'Therapy as a Service'. This session confirmed the bio and credentials are real, but found no publisher, ISBN, purchase link, or free-access link for the book itself anywhere — so per the founder's own instruction to 'confirm before citing', it's still not counted. On blogs: no dedicated business-of-therapy blog was confirmed this round, though privatepracticeskills.com (the channel above) has its own blog worth a closer look in a future pass.
